title: Beef Bouillabaisse Italiano
description: A creative twist on the classic French bouillabaisse, with Italian flavors and beef as the main ingredient.

ingredients.name: Bouillabaisse (French soup mix)
ingredients.notes: Follow instructions on packet for mix

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the canned tomatoes, white wine, beef broth, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Add the bouillabaisse mix to the pot and stir to combine.
Serve hot with crusty bread on the side.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
